dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: I can't quite get used to it. The level of Abyssal energy in Teyvat is quite low, but here, it's even lower still. It makes it hard for me to replenish the energy lost from training.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Of course, it's well within my abilities to connect this place directly to the Abyss, but... I'm sure you'd rather keep things peaceful and quiet here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... Is there anything we can do?

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: No need to worry. Spending some time here isn't without its benefits. I'll just treat it as a rehearsal.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: We don't always get to pick where we fight our battles. Sometimes, we have to fight in conditions that don't suit us. In a similar vein, Master once told me that we can't rely on one form of power forever.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: "If losing one source of power reduces you to a helpless heap, then you never deserved that power to begin with."

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: This place may slowly drain the Abyssal power from my body, but in exchange, I can hone my swordsmanship in a purer form. In that sense, it benefits me.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: So, despite not being used to it, I'm quite happy to stay here a while longer.
